sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents confirmed fraudulent activity investigated under case HHG-014. The primary subject of this investigation is customer C13487, holding card account C13487-K1. Between 2016-11-22 and 2016-11-22, the subject card account incurred unauthorized transactions totaling $74.96 USD. Investigation by the fraud unit confirmed unauthorized use consistent with undocumented. Forensic device analysis revealed that online authorizations originated from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080'. Cross-graph analysis detected that this infrastructure is shared across multiple cardholder accounts, specifically: C11923-K2, C13171-K2. The coordination of activity across distinct cardholder identities indicates an organized card fraud ring. Typology analysis: Coordinated card-not-present fraud ring utilizing Samsung SM-G935F devices behind anonymous proxies across multiple distinct cardholders. Customer and cardholder communications established that transactions were unrecognized and unauthorized by the legitimate account holder. Evidence synthesis: 4 graph and identity evidence claims collected. Total exposure in this fraudulent episode is confirmed at $74.96 USD. In accordance with bank fraud policy Section 3a: connected to shared device/ring across cards (R6); coordinated undocumented pattern (R9) and regulatory filing guidelines, card C13487-K1 has been blocked and reissued, connected accounts placed under heightened monitoring, and this suspicious activity report filed.
